description: Machine-readable provider parity registry. Every V1 provider is assessed against the same capability fields. Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, and Twilio are all V1 providers. Provider behavior is template/YAML/provider-pack driven — no one-off hardcoded implementations.

capability_fields.template_pack: Provider package exists (package.yaml + transform + events + fixtures + goldens)
capability_fields.signature_validation: Provider-specific HMAC/signature verification enforced at ingestion
capability_fields.replay_protection: Platform-level replay protection (idempotency window + nonce handling)
capability_fields.golden_payloads: Golden output fixtures for validated event types
capability_fields.restricted_live_e2e: Restricted live (cloud) end-to-end validation receipt captured

maturity_legend.PARTIAL: Artifact exists but has known gaps
maturity_legend.PENDING: Wired but not yet enforced or validated

stripe.negative_tests_note: Excluded from golden test suite (ST-02 blocker)

github.golden_note: Thinnest coverage (1 fixture; expansion to 5+ pending GH-01)

shopify.signature_note: HMAC enforcement PENDING in authprofile (V1_BLOCKER security)

parity_rules: No provider receives a weaker definition of 'supported'
Temporary maturity differences must be visible in this registry
Provider pages must use the same capability language as this registry
Provider behavior is template/YAML/provider-pack driven — do not imply one-off hardcoded provider implementations
Do not upgrade any provider to production_live before cloud production evidence exists
Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, and Twilio are all V1 providers with the same capability contract
non_claims: No provider is production-live or cloud-validated at V1 launch
No claim of provider registry GA or public-launch-go
Free is not evaluation-only — it is a permanent plan
No claim of broader compliance certification for any provider
